exposure: Presence or absence of risk factors associated with vaginal birth after cesarean section
Trial of labor after one previous cesarean section
cohort: 9712 women with one previous cesarean delivery in Senegal and Mali
finding: The risks of hospital-based maternal complications and perinatal mortality were significantly higher in women with a trial of labor after one previous cesarean compared with women who had an elective repeated cesarean section, but these differences were not significant when restricted to low-risk women.
